data.body: Empirical reproduction on up-to-date origin/main worktree /Users/joeoakhart/dw1-main-feature-inv at 083620b08116: added temporary src/rebar/_mechanism_marker_probe.py containing a new lock literal celadon_marker_probe.lock with exact adjacent marker '# mechanism-ok: lock celadon_marker_probe.lock — celadon-computable-smelts empirical marker admission probe'. With no baseline edit, python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check exited 0 and reported the dummy lock as admitted; the two named unit tests passed: tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree and tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree (2 passed). Scratch file removed afterward; worktree clean. A deliberately misplaced marker first failed both, confirming the valid-placement probe exercised marker admission rather than detector absence.
